title.tr: Restoran Salonunda Masif Ahşap Masalar ve Deri Sandalyeler
title.en: Solid Wood Tables and Leather Chairs in a Restaurant Dining Room

alt.tr: Büyük camlı bir salonda açık renk ahşap masalar, kahverengi deri döşemeli sandalyeler ve koyu renk ahşap parke zemin
alt.en: Restaurant dining room with light wood tables, brown leather chairs and dark wood floor beside large glass doors

caption.tr: Bahçeye bakan salonda açık tonlu ahşap masalar, deri döşemeli sandalyeler ve duvar kenarındaki uzun bar masası. Tavanda gizli ışıklı kaset detaylar var.
caption.en: Light-toned wooden tables, leather-upholstered chairs and a long wall counter in a dining room facing the garden, with a coffered ceiling lit by a concealed light strip.
